name: Pottery
definition: Creating functional and sculptural objects from clay
process: Handbuilding - Pinching, coiling, slab building + wheel throwing
outcome: Cups, bowls, sculptures

name: Kintsugi
definition: The Japanese art of repairing broken ceramics using lacquer mixed with metallic powder, celebrating imperfections rather than hiding them.
process: Broken ceramic pieces are joined, gaps filled with adhesive, and highlighted using gold, silver or brass powder.
outcome: Learn the philosophy of resilience and imperfection while creating a repaired keepsake bowl, plate or cup.

name: Bandhni/ Tie Dye
definition: A traditional resist-dyeing textile technique where fabric is tied into tiny knots before dyeing to create intricate patterns.
process: Fabric is tied with thread, dyed in natural or fabric dyes, dried and untied to reveal patterns.
outcome: Scarves or stoles or tote bags

name: Batik Print/ Wax resist dyeing
definition: A textile art where molten wax is applied to fabric to resist dyes, creating layered patterns.
process: Draw with hot wax using a tjanting or brush, dye fabric, remove wax, and repeat for multiple colours if required.
outcome: Understand resist dyeing techniques and create a unique batik scarf, tote or wall hanging.

name: Cyanotype printing
definition: An alternative photographic printing process that creates striking Prussian blue images using sunlight.
process: Coat paper or fabric with light-sensitive solution, arrange botanical elements or objects, expose to sunlight and wash with water.
outcome: Explore photography without a camera and take home botanical prints, bookmarks, greeting cards or framed artwork.

name: Kolhapuri Chappal Making
definition: Traditional handcrafted leather footwear
process: Pattern cutting, punching, stitching
outcome: 1 Pair of Kolhapuri chappal

name: Channapatna Toy Making
definition: Lac-turned wooden toy craft
process: Wood turning, lac colouring
outcome: Wooden dolls, toys

name: Madhubani Painting
definition: Folk painting using symbolic motifs
process: Line work and natural colours
outcome: Coasters or envelopes or  bookmarks or tote bags

name: Warli Painting
definition: Tribal storytelling art
process: Geometric forms and narratives
outcome: Coasters or envelopes or  bookmarks or tote bags

name: Gond Art
definition: Tribal dot and line art
process: Pattern building
outcome: Coasters or envelopes or  bookmarks or tote bags

name: Jaipur Tile Painting
definition: Hand-painting ceramic tiles
process: Pattern painting
outcome: Tiles, coasters

name: Portuguese Azulejo Tile Painting
definition: Decorative tile painting tradition
process: Blue and white motif painting
outcome: Tiles, coasters

name: Kaavi Art
definition: Traditional mural stencil art
process: Lime wash and stencil carving
outcome: Decorative panels

name: Block Printing
definition: Textile printing with carved blocks
process: Printing and dyeing
outcome: Tote bags

name: Kalamkari
definition: Hand-drawn textile painting
process: Pen drawing and dyeing
outcome: Scarves, artworks

name: Paper Mache
definition: Sculpting with paper pulp
process: Layering and painting
outcome: Masks, décor

name: Earth Dialogues / Naturalist Sculptor
definition: an immersive exploration of material, nature and cultural memory starting from natural resources and ending in paintings or sculptures.This is a nature-rooted advasi art practice that transforms traditional and discarded materials such as mud, cow dung, paper pulp, tree resin, charcoal, ochre and natural earth pigments into textured surfaces, exploring the relationship between Adivasi traditions, ancestral memory, spirituality, nature and the changing landscape of modern India.
process:
* Introduction to Adivasi philosophy of nature, the five elements and traditional mud architecture
* Understanding natural, recycled and locally available materials such as paper pulp, cow dung, tree resin, clay, charcoal and earth pigments
* Preparing and working with a natural textured pulp inspired by disappearing mud walls
* Creating a textured surface using traditional, tactile techniques
* Exploring natural pigments such as red ochre, yellow earth, charcoal and lime
* Participants develop their own visual language through forms, symbols, patterns and storytelling
* Layering textures and pigments to create an artwork inspired by nature, memory and ancestral traditions
outcome:
Participants create a unique textured artwork on a prepared natural surface, using eco-friendly and recyclable materials, which they can take home.

Key Takeaway

An experiential understanding of how art, ecology, indigenous knowledge and spirituality can coexist—while encouraging participants to rethink waste, reconnect with natural materials and appreciate traditional Indian ways of living in harmony with nature.

name: Resin Art
definition: An art form using epoxy resin to create glossy decorative artworks and functional objects.
process: Mixing resin and pigments, pouring, layering and curing.
outcome: Participants create coasters, trays, bookmarks or decorative artwork while learning resin techniques.

name: Candle Making
definition: The craft of creating decorative and scented candles using wax and fragrances.
process: Melting wax, adding fragrance and colour, pouring into moulds and finishing.
outcome: Participants make customised scented candles and learn the fundamentals of candle crafting.

name: Perfume Making
definition: The art of blending essential oils and fragrance notes to create personalised perfumes.
process: Understanding fragrance families, blending top, middle and base notes and bottling.
outcome: Participants formulate and take home their own signature fragrance.

name: Bollywood Dance Workshop
definition: A high-energy dance session inspired by Bollywood choreography and music.
process: Warm-up, rhythm training, choreography and group performance.
outcome: Participants improve coordination, confidence and teamwork while learning a complete dance routine.

name: Drum Circle
definition: A facilitated group drumming experience that encourages communication, collaboration and stress relief.
origin: Indigenous traditions across Africa, Native America and Latin America
process: Interactive rhythm exercises using hand drums and percussion instruments.
outcome: Participants experience improved teamwork, active listening, emotional release and collective creativity.

name: Choir Workshop
definition: A collaborative singing session focusing on harmony, rhythm and vocal confidence.
origin: Choral traditions across Europe and sacred musical traditions worldwide
process: Vocal warm-ups, harmony practice and group singing.
outcome: Participants build confidence, listening skills and collective musical expression.

name: Music Jam Session
definition: An informal collaborative music-making experience encouraging creativity and improvisation.
origin: Rooted in jazz, folk and contemporary music traditions
process: Participants sing or play instruments together through guided improvisation.
outcome: Participants strengthen collaboration, creativity and musical confidence in a relaxed setting.

name: Vocal Expression Workshop
definition: A guided workshop exploring voice as a tool for confidence, communication and self-expression.
origin: Contemporary vocal coaching and expressive arts practices
process: Breathing exercises, vocal warm-ups, resonance techniques and expressive activities.
outcome: Participants improve vocal confidence, communication and emotional expression.

name: Art Journaling
definition: A reflective practice combining writing, sketching, painting and collage to express thoughts and emotions creatively.
origin: Contemporary; inspired by journaling and mixed-media art practices
process: Guided prompts, drawing, painting, collage and reflection exercises.
outcome: Participants develop a personal creative journal with techniques for self-reflection and stress management.

name: Sound Healing
definition: A wellness practice using sound vibrations to promote relaxation and emotional balance.
origin: Ancient India, Tibet, Nepal and Indigenous cultures
process: Guided meditation using singing bowls, gongs, chimes, bells and other therapeutic instruments.
outcome: Participants experience deep relaxation, reduced stress and improved mental clarity.

name: Breathwork
definition: Guided breathing techniques designed to regulate the nervous system and improve emotional and physical wellbeing.
origin: Ancient Yogic Pranayama; modern therapeutic practices
process: Structured breathing exercises, mindfulness and guided relaxation.
outcome: Participants learn practical breathing techniques to manage stress, anxiety and improve focus.

name: Somatic Movement
definition: A body-awareness practice that improves movement, posture and emotional regulation through mindful movement.
origin: Somatic education (20th Century), influenced by Feldenkrais, Alexander Technique and Body-Mind Centering
process: Gentle guided movement, body awareness and breath integration exercises.
outcome: Participants improve body awareness, release physical tension and enhance mind-body connection.

name: Dance Movement Therapy
definition: A therapeutic approach using movement and dance to enhance emotional, cognitive and social wellbeing.
process: Guided movement, improvisation, rhythm exercises and group reflection.
outcome: Participants improve emotional expression, confidence, connection and stress relief through movement.

name: Pet Therapy
definition: A guided interaction with trained therapy animals to support emotional wellbeing and social connection.
process: Structured activities with certified therapy animals under professional supervision.
outcome: Participants experience reduced stress, increased positive emotions and improved social interaction.

name: Expressive Art Therapy
definition: A therapeutic approach using multiple creative modalities—visual art, movement, music and storytelling—for emotional expression and healing.
process: Guided creative exercises, reflection and facilitated sharing using different art forms.
outcome: Participants enhance self-awareness, emotional resilience and creative confidence through non-verbal expression.
